key_impacts: Severe social, economic and psychological impacts.
evidence_snippets: 17th January 1995… an earthquake… shook the city of Kobe and adjoining areas in Hyogo.
It took more than 6,400 lives, destroyed thousands of houses and left millions of people homeless.
Social, economic and psychological damages were profound.
Last year’s Niigata Earthquake… with a 6.8 magnitude.
Damages to buildings in Niigata were high.
Human toll—35 lives lost—was far less severe.
